article_title: How Carney plans to sell Canada to the world's biggest investors

tasks.prompt: What is Mark Carney trying to achieve through the Toronto investor summit?
options: Restore Canada's former sales pitch as a gateway to the US
Replace all foreign capital with government spending
Use global investment to build a more independent and resilient Canadian economy
Persuade Canada to abandon energy and resource projects
tasks.correct_answer: Use global investment to build a more independent and resilient Canadian economy
tasks.explanation_hebrew: קרני מבקש למשוך השקעות עולמיות לפרויקטים קנדיים כדי להפחית תלות בארה״ב ולחזק את עמידות הכלכלה.

tasks.prompt: What scale of investment is represented by the summit's invited guests?
options: About 20 investors controlling C$1tn
More than 100 investors overseeing over C$100tn in assets
Only Canadian pension funds managing C$5bn
Ten banks holding approximately US$100bn
tasks.correct_answer: More than 100 investors overseeing over C$100tn in assets
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לטורונטו הוזמנו יותר ממאה משקיעים המפקחים יחד על נכסים בהיקף העולה על 100 טריליון דולר קנדי.

tasks.prompt: What does it mean that Carney hopes to “woo” wealthy asset managers?
options: He intends to regulate their companies
He wants to investigate their past investments
He aims to persuade and attract them to invest in Canada
He plans to compete with them for Canadian pensions
tasks.correct_answer: He aims to persuade and attract them to invest in Canada
tasks.explanation_hebrew: woo פירושו לחזר ולשכנע; כאן קרני משתמש בקשריו ובניסיון הפיננסי כדי למשוך השקעות.

tasks.prompt: Which Canadian weakness did the CPP Investments report highlight?
options: A shortage of natural resources
A lack of political stability
Excessively close relations with Norway
Insufficient scale and depth of investible opportunities
tasks.correct_answer: Insufficient scale and depth of investible opportunities
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הדוח הזהיר שהחולשה העיקרית היא היקף ועומק מוגבלים של הזדמנויות שאפשר להשקיע בהן בפועל.

tasks.prompt: Why is Carney's former career in global finance presented as an advantage?
options: He has personal access to investors and understands how financiers think
It guarantees immediate investment announcements
It gives him power to approve provincial projects alone
It removes Canada's dependence on US trade
tasks.correct_answer: He has personal access to investors and understands how financiers think
tasks.explanation_hebrew: קשריו האישיים והבנתו העמוקה בפיננסים מסייעים לו להזמין מקבלי החלטות ולזהות את כוונותיהם במשא ומתן.

tasks.prompt: What does the phrase “valley of death” describe near the end of the article?
options: A geographic route between Canada and the US
A temporary fall in energy prices
The period after every investment summit
The dangerous gap before new trade partnerships can replace rapidly weakening US ties
tasks.correct_answer: The dangerous gap before new trade partnerships can replace rapidly weakening US ties
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתאר את תקופת הביניים המסוכנת שבה הקשר עם ארה״ב נחלש מהר יותר מהקמת שותפויות חלופיות.

tasks.prompt: Identify the sectors and strengths Carney plans to present to investors.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין משאבים ואנרגיה, יציבות פוליטית ותחומי ההשקעה המרכזיים.
expected_points: Canada's energy and resource sectors
Political stability
Artificial intelligence projects
Defence projects
Transportation projects
Infrastructure projects
The message that Canada has resources the world needs

tasks.prompt: Explain why overseas investment cannot fully solve Canada's trade problem with the US in the short term.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את משקל היצוא לארה״ב, הצורך ביציבות, זמן בניית שותפויות והצורך בפשרה.
expected_points: Exports to the US equal about 20% of Canada's GDP
Canada stands to lose heavily from a permanent rupture
Long-term investors need a stable US-Canada trading relationship
New global partnerships take time to develop
The US rift is unfolding more quickly than diversification
Both countries are still expected to negotiate and compromise

tasks.prompt: Summarise Carney's investment strategy, its advantages and the main barriers it faces.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית את הפסגה, ניסיונו של קרני, מטרת הגיוון, החסמים והסיכונים הפוליטיים.
expected_points: Carney invited major global funds and executives to Toronto
He uses personal finance-sector relationships and crisis-management experience
The pitch stresses resources, stability and major projects
Canada wants a more independent and resilient economy
Slow approvals and limited investible opportunities may deter capital
Provinces and indigenous communities must support major projects
US trade remains economically crucial
Protests and criticism focus on corporate interests, climate and controversial partners

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced investor briefing assessing whether Canada is an attractive long-term investment after the summit.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית הערכה מאוזנת הכוללת נכסים, הנהגה, תחומים, סחר, אישורים, בעלי עניין וסיכוני תקופת המעבר.
expected_points: Describe Canada's resources and political stability
Identify AI, defence, transport and infrastructure opportunities
Assess Carney's financial network and experience
Address slow project approvals
Discuss provincial and indigenous consent
Quantify dependence on US trade
Consider diversification opportunities and timing
Address domestic investment and public opposition
Reach a qualified conclusion rather than guaranteeing success
